"THE WAY OF THE SAMURAI

Full 3D Japanese Crafting @COMMENT_BODY@ Business Simulation

Create a beautiful, immersive 3D Japanese-inspired life simulation and business management game.

You play as a samurai who has left warfare behind to live peacefully in the Japanese mountains. Your goal is to build a successful estate through bonsai cultivation, gardening, traditional weapon crafting and trading.

1. YOUR ESTATE @COMMENT_BODY@ BONSAI GARDEN

Start with a small traditional Japanese house, a garden and a basic workshop.

Grow and cultivate different trees and flowers, including Japanese maple, cherry blossom, juniper, pine and bamboo.

Create and maintain beautiful bonsai through watering, pruning, wiring, shaping and repotting. Each tree has its own age, health, rarity, appearance and value.

Living Bonsai Legacy: Trees grow and develop over time. Rare trees can take years in-game to become masterpieces worth enormous amounts of money. Players can sell them at auctions or preserve them as family heirlooms and centrepieces of their estate.

Expand your garden with ponds, bridges, stone lanterns, decorative paths and traditional Japanese architecture.

2. BLACKSMITHING @COMMENT_BODY@ WEAPON CRAFTING

Build and upgrade a traditional Japanese blacksmith workshop.

Craft:

- Katana, Wakizashi, Tanto and Nodachi.
- Sai, Kunai and Naginata.
- Spears, bows and other traditional weapons.
- Samurai armour and decorative accessories.

Include interactive crafting stages such as heating, hammering, folding steel, sharpening, polishing and decorating.

Weapons have individual quality, materials, durability, rarity, appearance and value.

Legendary Weapons: Discover extremely rare materials and unlock secret crafting techniques to create unique legendary weapons. These creations attract wealthy samurai, collectors and supernatural buyers.

3. THE MOUNTAIN AUCTION

Create a beautiful Japanese mountain marketplace where players sell their bonsai, weapons and crafted goods.

Different NPC buyers include:

- Samurai looking for exceptional weapons.
- Buddhist monks collecting rare bonsai.
- Wealthy merchants seeking valuable items.
- Nobles collecting luxury decorations.
- Oni interested in mysterious and legendary creations.

Implement a proper auction system with starting bids, competing buyers, bidding wars, negotiations, seasonal demand and special auctions.

Different buyers have different preferences and budgets. Every item should have its own market value.

4. THE SECRET ONI BLACK MARKET

Introduce a mysterious underground auction that only appears at night.

Oni and supernatural merchants trade unusual and forbidden items.

Discover:

- Enchanted metals.
- Ancient seeds.
- Rare supernatural wood.
- Mysterious bonsai species.
- Forbidden weapon blueprints.
- Legendary crafting materials.

These items allow players to create extraordinary bonsai and weapons that cannot be produced through normal crafting.

The Oni market should be mysterious, rare and rewarding, adding fantasy elements without turning the peaceful game into a combat game.

5. ECONOMY @COMMENT_BODY@ PROGRESSION

Earn money through auctions and use it to:

- Purchase better materials and rare seeds.
- Upgrade workshops and equipment.
- Expand your property.
- Unlock new bonsai species and weapon designs.
- Hire gardeners and blacksmith assistants.
- Discover advanced crafting techniques.

Start as an unknown craftsman and gradually become one of Japan's most respected artisans.

Include reputation, customer relationships, rare commissions and increasingly wealthy buyers.

6. WORLD @COMMENT_BODY@ ENVIRONMENT

Create an explorable Japanese mountain environment containing:

- Bamboo forests.
- Cherry blossom valleys.
- Ancient temples and shrines.
- Mountain waterfalls and rivers.
- Mining caves.
- Traditional Japanese villages.
- Merchant settlements.
- The mountain auction grounds.

Include a complete seasonal system:
Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter.

Seasons, weather and time should influence bonsai growth, market demand and the appearance of the world.

7. VISUALS @COMMENT_BODY@ GAMEPLAY

Fully 3D, beautiful Japanese-inspired graphics with detailed environments, realistic crafting animations, dynamic lighting, day/night cycles and peaceful traditional Japanese-inspired music.

The game should be relaxing, rewarding and immersive.

CORE GAMEPLAY LOOP

GROW BONSAI → CRAFT WEAPONS → DISCOVER RARE MATERIALS → SELL AT AUCTION → EARN MONEY → UPGRADE YOUR ESTATE → CREATE LEGENDARY MASTERPIECES.

IMPORTANT: Prioritise fully functional gameplay systems over decorative features. Bonsai cultivation, weapon crafting, auctions, the economy and estate progression must all be playable and interconnected.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

  open [url]                  open the browser

  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url

  hover <target>              hover over element on page

  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
